title: Rook - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: An AI agent that lives in your browser to research, organize, automate, and get work done across tabs, apps, and local files.
content_html:
Overview

An AI agent that lives in your browser to research, organize, automate, and get work done across tabs, apps, and local files.

Rook is an AI agent that lives in your browser. Ask it to research across tabs, organize your browser, work with connected apps, create files, or repeat a task on a schedule. You can: - research and take action across multiple tabs; - organize tabs, bookmarks, history, and downloads; - work with Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, and other connected services; - create reusable skills, scripts, conversations, and files; - choose local folders for a task; and - schedule recurring routines. Browser actions remain visible in the tabs they affect. The agent completes ordinary sign-in and consent flows itself; physical-presence controls such as a CAPTCHA, hardware key, or phone challenge wait for you in the affected tab. Turn one-off work into reusable skills and routines, then run them again whenever you need them. Sign in with ChatGPT to get started. Connected services and local folders are optional—you choose what the agent can use.
